criteria.description: The displayed local Generate CV error about empty candidate evidence is removed when the owner's supported evidence source contains usable evidence.
criteria.source: fix this: screenshot shows 'Candidate evidence is empty' in Generate CV
criteria.verification: reproduce the owner preview boundary before and after and inspect the rendered dialog

criteria.description: The corrected evidence reaches the existing CV preview/generation path rather than merely hiding the error.
criteria.source: baseline: fixing a generation-blocking error must restore the blocked workflow
criteria.verification: measure the preview response and exercise generation up to a fake model boundary

criteria.description: The fix does not fabricate candidate evidence or expose another user's evidence.
criteria.source: baseline: candidate CV content must remain truthful and owner-scoped
criteria.verification: test source precedence with synthetic owner, file, empty, and non-owner evidence

criteria.description: A genuinely empty supported evidence source still fails closed with an actionable error.
criteria.source: baseline: fixing the false empty state must not permit evidence-free CV generation
criteria.verification: run the empty-source regression and assert the existing error remains

criteria.description: Load-bearing claims about the configured file, runtime environment, and workflow outcome are measured rather than asserted.
criteria.source: baseline: a claim that decides the verdict must be measured
criteria.verification: inspect runtime path/file bytes, account evidence, API response, tests, and browser DOM
